XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Noise and vibrations coming from the headrest when driving on rough roads
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: BODYWORK | BACKREST | SEAT | CUSHION | NOISE | VIBRATION | STRESS | JOLTS | BEARING | TRAVEL | GUIDES | CHASSIS | IRREGULARITIES | 35686 |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: Cars manufactured between 01/01/19 and 31/12/19

  • System: Bodywork

  • Device: Headrest guides

  • Fault: Noise and vibrations are heard coming from the headrest while driving, mainly on rough roads

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Incorrect clearance between the headrest cover and the backrest frame

• Intervention: Replacement of headrest guides

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: Headrest guide product code: 876036195R
